## About

Amol Shukla is an AI Developer, Trainer, and Agentic AI Expert. He builds agentic AI systems (ReAct-style agent pipelines, tool-calling systems, production LLM workflows), trains developers and data professionals on Python, machine learning, and generative AI, and ships production software with Python, FastAPI, Next.js, React, and TypeScript.

## Articles

- [Deep Dive into Transformers and Self-Attention Mechanisms](https://www.amolshukla.online/blogs/deep-dive-into-transformers-and-self-attention-mechanisms): Mathematical breakdown of self-attention, multi-head attention, positional encodings, and a NumPy implementation.
- [How to Build an LLM RAG Pipeline with Next.js and FastAPI](https://www.amolshukla.online/blogs/how-to-build-an-llm-rag-pipeline-with-nextjs-and-fastapi): Production-ready RAG architecture — ingestion, chunking, FastAPI backend, Next.js chat UI, caching and rate limiting.
- [Mastering Python Generators for Memory-Efficient Data Pipelines](https://www.amolshukla.online/blogs/mastering-python-generators-for-memory-efficient-data-pipelines): Streaming data lazily with yield, pipeline chains, and coroutine patterns.
- [Understanding Vector Databases: Pinecone vs Chroma vs Qdrant](https://www.amolshukla.online/blogs/understanding-vector-databases-pinecone-vs-chroma-vs-qdrant): Comparison of the leading vector stores for production LLM systems.
